svg.title: Dragon Database — Steel Masthead banner refinements v7
svg.desc: Inset and full-bleed top-banner variations of Steel Masthead. Both move the steel banner beneath the header and add curling black flames, subtle flying dragon silhouettes, scales on the Scaling S, and dragon eyes inside the two Collection o letters.
svg.metadata: Landing page hero design concept. Illustrative archive copy and dragon type cards. Selected v8 Swordslapper Classic underline logo foreground reused unchanged. Restrained editorial typography; Alegreya Sans is licensed in logos/v7/fonts, and optional Grenze Regular in logos/v6/fonts. DragonSlapper by Allison James (NAL), copyright 2013, via https://www.fontstruct.com/fontstructions/show/830154/dragonslapper; CC BY-SA 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Original font file unchanged; the outlined glyphs included here remain under CC BY-SA 3.0. Not an implemented application.

g.title: Dragon Database — Steel Masthead Inset Desktop Concept
g.desc: A steel-and-black Scaling Collection hero with a inset brushed-steel banner directly beneath the header, separated by a quiet gap. Curled black flame tongues and small flying dragon silhouettes frame the unchanged archive mark. The centered title includes scales inside the Scaling S and steel dragon eyes in both Collection o letters. Search, public browsing, a black Sign In button, and three steel-accented type cards complete the layout.
g.metadata: Landing page hero design concept. Illustrative archive copy and dragon type cards. Selected v8 Swordslapper Classic underline logo foreground reused unchanged. g.desc: The selected Swordmaw Hybrid dragon, wings, DB monogram and crossed swords with a new DragonSlapper Dragon Database wordmark. Both words align to the full width of the original horizontal sword beneath the lettering. Black on silver.

g.title: Dragon Database — Steel Masthead Inset Mobile Concept
g.desc: A compact silver-and-black mobile archive with a inset steel banner immediately below the selected Editorial header. Curled black flames and subtle flying dragons flank the original archive mark. The Scaling Collection heading keeps its scale-decorated S and two dragon-eye o letters. Search, public browsing, black Sign In, and two steel-accented dragon type cards remain visible.
